// fishSpecies: Give each fish one of eight species with its own shape and pattern, derived from its name (default: false)
// uiStyle: 'classic': name cards on the fish, top banner, QR panel and all side lists. 'minimal': compact name, health dots and age text above the fish, no banner and no side lists, the QR code on a wooden sign in the tank that also shows the feeding status, and only the relevant status pills
// showPanels: Optional: show or hide individual side lists regardless of uiStyle, e.g. { "activity": true } to show the activity list in minimal. Keys: newest, stars, legends, memorial, activity, version. Lists you leave out follow the style (on in classic, off in minimal)
// hungerRate: Health loss per 10 min from hunger (default: 0.167, ~4 days to die)
// diseaseRate: Extra health loss per 10 min when sick and not medicated (default: 0.083)
